value.answer: This needs emergency care now - go to the ER. Fever with a stiff, painful neck and light hurting the eyes is a combination doctors want to see right away, not watch at home.
value.triage: Go to the ER now. Call 911 right away if your child is drowsy, confused, hard to wake, has a seizure, a rash that does not fade when pressed, or if you cannot get to the ER fast. Do not stop to call 811 first.
